# The repository's own guides that the corpus tests read, one path per line from the repository
# root. envoy-go and envoy-go-docs-finalizers write each one into one flat directory, under its path
# with each / as __, and point the corpus variables at it: PMDOC_ANCHOR_CORPUS,
# DISPATCH_RENDER_CORPUS and PMDOC_WALK_CORPUS (internal/dispatch/pmdoc), DISPATCH_TOKEN_CORPUS and
# DISPATCH_TEST_SPEC_CORPUS (internal/dispatch/docs). envoy-go's pmdoc differential reads them too.
#
# A guide is here only when every one of those tests can take it as a document: at most 1 MiB,
# the largest markdown document Dispatch stores (TestWriteCorpusReadsOnce seeds each one); three
# paragraphs that each hold a phrase found once, two of them top-level and the third top-level or
# in a list item or table cell (chooseWriteCorpusQuotes, the writes of TestWriteCorpusReadsOnce);
# and at least 98 candidate sentences (pickQuotes, the anchors of
# TestAMarginWriteMatchesTheWholeDocumentWrite). Those rules leave out every AGENTS.md of the
# repository, each now cut to its purpose, components, pointers and rules, and every README.md but
# the ones here. The rest are docs pages, never a CLAUDE.md, a SKILL.md or a file under skills/,
# which the guides' owner rewrites the same way: docs/testing.md took the place of
# scripts/dispatch/README.md when that guide fell below 98, and the five pages before it took the
# places of the five AGENTS.md files the cut left below the rules, chosen among the docs pages that
# meet them for their few bytes and their margin over 98 (docs/kubernetes.md meets them too, but
# stands within a tenth of the 1 MiB and grows by that much in days).
# Both jobs' comments give their times over the fifteen guides this list held on 2026-11-18, about
# 3.6 MB then. It holds fifteen, about 2.2 MB, so those times still bound it; a change that adds a
# guide or takes the list past 3.6 MB measures the jobs again.
# Both jobs' filters name this file and every path in it (the repository_markdown group of
# .github/ci-filters.yaml, which envoy_go and envoy_go_race_docs name), and
# .github/scripts/ci_job_reads.py reads the paths from this file as the two jobs' reads, so a change
# to one of these guides starts the jobs that read it. A path added here is a path that group must
# name too.
docs/site/src/content/docs/dispatch/delivery.md
docs/site/src/content/docs/dispatch/issues-and-projects.md
docs/site/src/content/docs/legion/concepts.md
docs/solutions/github/join-a-job-to-the-ci-router.md
docs/solutions/legion/worker-pane-shell-gotchas.md
docs/testing.md
packages/claude-envoy/README.md
packages/dispatch/README.md
packages/envoy-client/README.md
packages/envoy/cmd/dispatch/README.md
packages/envoy/infra/README.md
packages/envoy/loadtest/README.md
packages/envoy/scripts/README.md
packages/pi-envoy/README.md
scripts/e2e/README.md
